TextBlock.Text: BANDA SEA, 2034. None of this is real and none of it is a forecast. The YF-23 went into production in this timeline, the AIM-260 and the AIM-424 exist in quantity, the Rafale F5 carries LRASM and the J-36 and J-50 are operational squadrons rather than airframes on a taxiway. A bomber stream is going north-west against a relocatable launcher complex with the RQ-180 ahead of it, and the opposing force has put up everything it does not officially have. Treat the weapons performance here as authored fiction. It is the branch where the collection's experimental content gets to be the point instead of an embarrassing exception in a 2028 briefing.
None of this is real and none of it is a forecast. The stream releases on the complex or it does not. Get the escorts home either way; even in fiction, range is range.
Stream: Get the bomber stream through to release Escort: Keep the escort fighters alive Sensor: Keep the RQ-180 on task
Two YF-23, one F-15EX, an F-16CM with JATM, a Rafale F5, the RQ-180, a B-52O, a B-1B and a B-52H in the stream. Opposing: J-36, J-50, a Tu-95MA with Meteorit and a relocatable launcher complex.
80 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

YF-23 Black Widow II, F-15 EX Eagle II, RQ-180 White Bat Airframe, B-1B Lancer, B-52H Stratofortress, J-36 Tailless Fighter, Shenyang J-50 (沈阳航空工业 歼-50), 3M25 <<МЕТЕОРИТ>> (AS-X-19 Koala), PLA Land Unit Pack, Type 003 Fujian / Type 004 CVN Aircraft Carriers, Modern Chinese Airbase (Large), Gerald R. Ford-class CVN Aircraft Carrier (Updated Dependencies), the base game, this pack.
